skill.summary: 加密货币持仓监控工具。支持多钱包地址监控、实时价格查询、持仓统计。

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of crypto-holdings-monitor.

- Monitor holdings across multiple crypto wallet addresses (BTC, ETH, SOL, etc.)
- Real-time USDC/USD price queries
- Portfolio statistics and position analysis
- Profit calculation based on purchase cost
- Scheduled notifications for portfolio changes
- Command-line usage: add/view addresses, refresh prices, generate reports
